{{distinguish|Cohen–Macaulay ring}}
{{for|the Boolean algebras used in set theory|Cohen algebra}}
In [[algebra]], a '''Cohen ring''' is a field or a complete [[discrete valuation ring]] of [[mixed characteristic]] <math>(0, p)</math> whose [[maximal ideal]] is generated by ''p''. Cohen rings are used in the [[Cohen structure theorem]] for [[complete ring|complete]] [[Noetherian ring|Noetherian]] [[local ring]]s.
